features: MegaVideo Compact MJPEG IP camera series
Available in color or day/night and 1.3, 2, 3 and 5 megapixel resolutions
Approximately half the size and one-third lighter than full-size MegaVideo counterparts
Superior low-light performance: 1/2 in. CMOS sensor
Multistreaming: up to eight concurrent non-identical streams
Real-time streaming protocol (RTSP) compatible with QuickTime, Windows Media Player and VLC
Fast megapixel image rates: up to 32 fps in 1.3 megapixel mode, 24 fps in 2 megapixel mode
Region of interest (ROI), image cropping, motion detection, motorized IR-cut filter
